answer: Make every identity solve a fresh memory-hard puzzle each epoch, bound to its own key. Step 1: a newcomer stakes 100 POA and gets an epoch-seeded puzzle needing 16 GB of RAM and 10 minutes of work. Step 2: it submits inside a five-minute window; late or copied answers slash the stake. Step 3: verifiers check it in seconds, and the proof repeats next epoch, so a farm cannot rest. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 16 TB of live RAM, 250 servers at about $125 per epoch, plus 100,000 POA locked. Like a reef, each polyp must hold its own thread of current; a whisper of copied work is exposed at once.
